title: najas marina var. angustifolia
intro: Najas marina var. angustifolia, commonly known as the narrow-leaved Najas, is a submerged aquatic plant species belonging to the Najadaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Najas marina var. angustifolia include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
